_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Sparkflights deal cards with the destination photo, price, dates and a link to each fare page.

description: One Sparkflights fare by the numeric id from search_deals: its itinerary, the price text of its fare page, its outbound and return flights, the date pairs its fare page lists with their prices, and its url, route_url and feed_url. A fare that is no longer live returns an error naming its route page.
name: get_deal
